fixes.explanation: Egypt, huh? Nice guess, but Joshua's not looking that far back. He says, "If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!" (Joshua 7:7). That's the river they just crossed. I think he's so upset, he's wishing the whole trip undone, and the trip started on the Jordan's far bank, not in Egypt.

They "spread them out before the LORD" (Joshua 7:23). Think about that. Achan dug a hole in his tent and hid that stuff like it was a secret he'd never have to explain. Now the cloak, the silver and the gold bar are laid out in the open like a yard sale nobody wanted. Verse 22 says it was all there with the silver underneath, just as he said. I know a little about being stuffed out of sight, baker, and it never lasts as long as you think.
